original_plan.name: dual-mit-j5-j7-j5-j4-j1-j2-20261116
original_plan.description: 用户更正第二步为J7，第三步J5从-88度回到本次零点0度，实际回转88度；接线检查/复位已确认，运动仍待最终表审核。

baseline.zero_policy: Test-relative reference only; persistent calibration is unchanged

caveat: Offline alternatives only; targets are not adopted or user-authorized. Sampled model contact checks do not establish real collision clearance.

recommended_for_user_review_only.reason: Among the requested angle candidates, J7 +30 is contact-free in the model; J5 -85 retains >3 degrees of lower-bound margin on the limiting right axis.

high_density_validation.limit_check: All knots; monotone quintic interval extrema
high_density_validation.torque_model: M(q) qdd + bias(q,qd) - passive(q,qd) + frictionloss sign(qd)
caveats: Sampled model estimates are not measured torques or guaranteed upper bounds.
V1 original gripper CAD masses/inertias and approximate motor/gearbox inertia/damping are used.
External cable loads and unmodeled payloads are excluded; prior real load exceeded this model.
Static hold figures are gravity only, excluding uncertain static friction and external loads.
Contacts cover model collision meshes only, excluding cables, tables and people.
When contacts are detected, reported torques exclude contact forces and cannot validate that path.
Timing excludes measured settling; dwell begins after actual arrival.
